description: GridOS is GE Vernova's grid orchestration software portfolio, marketed as the first software portfolio designed specifically for grid orchestration so that utilities can manage the energy transition while driving reliability and resilience against security and weather threats. The product page announces GridOS for Distribution as a unified solution, claims customers have managed grids with up to 70% renewables penetration, and cites up to about 40% lower inertia management costs from a single demonstration project with the UK system operator, with a disclaimer that results vary with the generation mix. It also refers to a partner ecosystem of companies that help customers adopt the software. Access: commercial product offered through sales contact; the page has an overview video and an ebook but no price, licence text or trial. Coverage is utility grids worldwide. Caveats: this is vendor marketing, performance claims are unverified, and the deployment model was inferred from general cloud and on-premise utility software practice, not stated on the page. It suits network flow and resilience studies of utility operations software and vendor capability comparisons, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
